skill.summary: Build scalable, themable Tailwind CSS component libraries using CVA for variants, compound components, design tokens, dark mode, and responsive grids.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Tailwind Design System skill.

- Introduces scalable patterns for building component libraries with Tailwind CSS, including CVA, compound components, design tokens, and theming.
- Provides copy-paste examples for type-safe variant components, composable card components, validated form inputs, and a responsive grid system.
- Guides users through utility setup, design token architecture, and responsive/dark mode best practices.
- Includes installation and usage instructions for common UI patterns.
